openChange.when: The dialog asks to close because of the user: its close button, Escape, a press on the backdrop.

rules: A dialog is a modal window for a short task or a decision that must be completed or abandoned before going back to the page (confirm a deletion, edit a record, choose an option). While it is open the rest of the page is inert. Free content next to a trigger that does not block the page is a Popover; a message that needs no answer is an Alert or a Toast.

Layout inside panel: header (title, then description, with the close button at the inline end of the title line), body, footer, separated by sectionGap; padding surrounds them and headerGap separates title from description. title is required plain text in typographyTitle and content; description is optional plain text in typographyDescription and descriptionColor; body holds free content in typography and content.

panel is painted in surface with shadow, an edge of borderWidth in elevationColor and radius corners. It is centered in the viewport; its inline size is inlineSize, or the viewport inline size less viewportMargin on each side when smaller, and its block size follows the content up to the viewport block size less viewportMargin on each side.

When the content is taller than the panel allows, the body scrolls while the header and the footer stay in place, and scrolled is true; header and footer are then separated from the body by a line of borderWidth in dividerColor.

The body keeps a room of focusWidth plus focusOffset around its content, inside its scrolling area, so that the focus indicator of a control at its edge is never clipped and never makes the body scroll.
footer holds at most one ButtonGroup aligned at the end; the primary action is the last item.
backdrop covers the whole viewport behind the panel in backdropColor; the page under it does not scroll.
The dialog is exposed as a modal dialog named by title and described by description; with alert true it is an alert dialog, which asks for a decision.

On opening, focus moves to the element the application marks as the initial focus, otherwise to the first focusable element of the body, then of the footer, otherwise to the panel itself. Sequential focus stays inside the dialog. On closing, focus returns to the element that had it before opening, normally the trigger.

When dismissible is true, the close button shows a small ghost neutral IconButton with the intrinsic close glyph and closeLabel as its accessible name, and Escape and a press on the backdrop also ask to close. When dismissible is false (a dialog that requires an explicit choice), there is no close button, the backdrop ignores presses and Escape does nothing; the footer offers the way out. An alert dialog is never closed by a press on the backdrop.

Asking to close emits openChange with false and closes the dialog; setting open from the application opens or closes it without emitting openChange. A dialog opened from inside another dialog stacks above it, and Escape closes the innermost first.
The dialog inherits the brand, appearance and density of the place it is declared in. Where the platform has no top layer, it is stacked at layer.

It enters by fading in and moving enterDistance upwards over motionDuration with easingEnter, the backdrop fading in with it, and leaves by fading out over motionDuration with easingExit; under reduced motion it only fades.
In forced-colors mode the panel keeps a visible edge in the system text color.
